status_definitions.addressed: The specific requested availability/disclosure/scoped evidence is present. Input availability does not imply independent truth validation or completed historical replay.
status_definitions.partially_addressed: Material progress exists but a named substantive part or study remains open.
status_definitions.unsupported: Requested assertion or validation has no supporting completed evidence; no implication of intentional fabrication.
status_definitions.unavailable: The specific original run or proposal material required is not present in the inspected local artifacts/pinned repository commit; this is not a claim that it never existed or cannot be recovered elsewhere.
